method: Second intensive review using source/control-flow tracing, Rizin, Capstone, Unicorn instruction emulation, and Lua 5.1 with all native/IO capabilities stubbed. Scanner labels and external reputation were not verdict evidence.

samples.identification: cftunnel source distribution with deceptive README links and a malicious LuaJIT sidecar
evidence: The Go module declares github.com/qingchencloud/cftunnel. main.go -> cmd.Execute uses Cobra; daemon and relay code download cloudflared/frp for requested tunnel operations. Self-update uses qingchencloud release assets; authproxy implements local tunnel authentication. These capabilities alone do not establish an attack.

The README substitutes the same raw docs/Software_2.6.zip URL for release badges, other projects, installation commands, source clone commands, API-token guidance and contact links. The bundled ZIP contains Launcher.bat (start loader.exe proto.txt), a LuaJIT interpreter, lua51.dll and 308887 bytes of obfuscated Lua under a .txt suffix. The payload is unrelated to the tunnel manager.

The Lua VM uses arithmetic-flattened state dispatch, decimal escapes and shuffled string fragments. Facts recovered a 298286-byte partial fold. A stubbed Lua runtime recovered the decoder at VM entry state 15001864 and decoded 1005 constant-call instances without permitting native calls, shell execution or network I/O.

Native API resolution builds PEB-reading machine code in RWX memory, walks PE exports, and casts resolved pointers to callable FFI types. The live stub trace reached VirtualAlloc(NULL,10,12288,64), copied a gs:[0x60] getter and stopped before native execution.

Recovered state blocks construct powershell Start-Process with randomized block comments, -Verb RunAs, hidden windows and Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath $env:SystemDrive -ExclusionExtension .exe,.dll -Force, then hand the command to the WinExec wrapper. Separate blocks construct schtasks /create /sc daily with randomized time, task name and action, and a Setup.exe highest-runlevel variant.

The decoded code issues eth_call against multiple Polygon RPC providers to resolve control configuration, with a direct-IP fallback. Its WinInet wrappers open POST requests to /api/<id>, include loader/GUID/computer/user fields, accept loader configuration, write downloaded bytes and dispatch EXE/DLL/PowerShell paths through WinExec/rundll32. GDI capture constructs a DIB, BitBlt copies the display with SRCCOPY, and ffi.string serializes bitmap bytes for multipart transfer.
samples.context_missing: No user authorization or deployment telemetry was supplied. Defender bypass, covert persistence, remote payload execution and deceptive delivery tip the judgment; neither the tunnel capabilities nor a scanner score does.

samples.identification: Importless x64 Windows credential stealer and payload loader
evidence: Rizin and Capstone identify an importless native x64 PE. Entry 0x5e000a2e0 initializes hashed APIs at 0x5e000fe50 and uses an argument/on-disk marker gate; the unconfigured marker branch can show a VIRUS warning. That gate is not evidence of consent for deployed copies.

String-key routine 0x5e003badc reads the PEB image base and process heap pointers. It returns 0x6d0d8b43 when both are present and 0xdeadbeef otherwise. Unicorn emulation with a synthetic populated PEB, a stub allocator and no OS APIs recovered 699 cached string accessors. No original application entry point was run on the host.

The hash at 0x5e000fb3c starts at 0xb4b8026f and performs (hash XOR byte)*0x010003c9. Resolver 0x5e0010720 walks PE exports and compares hashes. Routine 0x5e00261c4 resolves and stores the WinHTTP client; constants independently recomputed to WinHttpOpen=0x4fe090b3 and WinHttpReadData=0x73b65ffd.

Orchestrator 0x5e0028eb0 calls configuration/anti-VM initialization, browser-key/file collection, staged task processing and final transfer. Routine 0x5e0027394 obtains browser key material, can terminate browsers before copying, invokes the Discord collector at 0x5e003b4b4 and proceeds into file handling. This is execution flow beyond a store-name string list.

Routine 0x5e0026a30 reads browser Local State, handles DPAPI and APPB prefixes, resolves CryptUnprotectData by hash 0xbf1ef18b at 0x5e002716f and invokes the resolved function at 0x5e00271a9/0x5e00271d3. It copies recovered key bytes into its caller-provided buffer. Additional browser-key code performs fork/process-memory and APC-related acquisition.

FileZilla collector 0x5e0007614 reads recentservers.xml, extracts Host/Port/User and Pass encoding=base64, decodes credentials and assembles Login/Password output. Discord collectors acquire/decrypt tokens from Local State and LevelDB. Steam and Telegram paths stage session files; browser collectors stage Login Data, cookies, histories and Firefox key/logins databases.

Routine 0x5e002543c packages buffers into multipart form data and calls 0x5e0024acc, which uses the WinHTTP pointers resolved by 0x5e00261c4 to open/send/read requests. Configuration initialization at 0x5e0006b18 supplies a non-vendor HTTPS endpoint. This source/staging/transfer chain, rather than concealment alone, establishes the stealer verdict.
samples.trait_coverage: Four suspicious findings: PEB decoy constant, importless PEB/RWX/API-hash co-occurrence, near-FNV API family and concealed WinHTTP table. Existing hostile signatures were overclaims; no new hostile count was invented from APIs alone.
samples.context_missing: No legitimate credential export workflow, authorization, or deployment telemetry was supplied. Multi-application session/key acquisition with remote transfer and hidden task/payload processing tips the judgment; the precise commercial/family identity is not established.

samples.identification: Udydn file-tasked Java shell bridge with trace deletion
evidence: run() enumerates data/content, selects names ending .cmd, reads a corresponding Base64 command, chooses cmd.exe /c or /bin/sh -c, starts ProcessBuilder, reads stdout and writes a .out file. It then deletes task/response artifacts.

The implementation appends .cmd to a name that already ends .cmd: foo.cmd causes it to read foo.cmd.cmd. That filename bug and whole-run exception swallowing can prevent task execution and later cleanup. Output is deleted immediately, so a reliable response-consumption protocol is not established.

After a successful loop, wipeLogs deletes active server.log and server.log.* plus data/internal/derby.log. selfDestruct deletes lib/Udydn.class. The public class matches this path in this sample, but the old generic .class-deletion matcher could not prove self-deletion in arbitrary programs.

run is a public method with no main or static initializer. An application/framework invocation is required. The prose mentions PaperCut and a CVE, but the source implements no exploit and provides no evidence that the CVE claim is real.
samples.context_missing: The caller, task-file writer and application deployment are absent. Arbitrary OS shell tasks coupled to active application/database log deletion and class removal make malicious intent likely despite the task-name bug.

trait_changes: Move near-FNV immediate/hash-byte observations to metadata/binary/instruction/operand with descriptive names; require the algorithm/loader family for WinHTTP concealment and lower that composite to suspicious.
Move multiply-by-31 from API hashing to an instruction operand. Remove it from hash-primitive consumers: in this sample it indexes a stack string, not a DJB2 hash.

Move the 0x40 argument-register constant and one 0x3c pointer load from memory allocation/embedded payload to instruction operands. Exclude SIB-index forms from the displacement matcher; make the existing repeated-load rule consume the canonical single-instruction atom. Exact consumers follow the moves.
Add a general PEB pointer/decoy-constant detection without a sample name, actual key, C2 or file offset.

Require server-log deletion and a 50-line proximity bound for hostile source-form Java shell tasking. Remove the read/write co-occurrence rule labeled as flow and the redundant self-erasing-class hostile rule.

Move arbitrary .class deletion to neutral filesystem deletion and match parsed call nodes, excluding comments. Move Java log-deletion mechanics from rotation to file deletion; path-only log names go to fs/path/log/application. Correct ATT&CK log-file deletion to T1070.004.
Move the Lua string-count measurement into metadata string population. Retain the two verified Lua hostile rules.
Retire the generic curl pipeline mislabeled as an agent session hook; the existing neutral pipeline capability remains.

Move the Go SSH private-key path reference out of credential-access; move the FRP repository reference out of product identity. Split docker-compose.yml and celerybeat-schedule references into configuration and scheduler metadata-store paths, preserving the OR alternatives in both Marimo consumers.

reference_audit.policy: No migrated directory reference is used to replace a partial explicit member set. Exact references were updated throughout all four tiers. The Marimo any-lists have needs=1, so splitting their old filename union preserves cardinality. Source atoms not moved in partially changed files remain in place. Target rescan diffs check the selected samples for accidental promotion.
intentional_scope_changes: SIB displacements removed from the old broad three-byte PE walk matcher; x86 architecture made explicit.
Java .class text matcher changed to parsed call matching; comment-only deletion is a near miss.
The Java active/rotated log predicates become literal name references with a less assertive deletion-co-occurrence description; direct rotated-log and Derby deletion evidence is retained.
Source-form Java hostile tasking now requires log deletion in a 50-line span.
The broad multiplier no longer supplies hashing evidence.
reviewed_ancestor_effects: The xz compression-library embedded-binary consumer is ELF-only; the removed PE-only pointer-load atom could never satisfy it. Other embedded format atoms remain.

The broad FRP/dual-use exclusions no longer accept a repository reference as tool identity. Actual FRP build identity and binary-context rules remain, and frp-binary-context retains the exact repo leg via its neutral URL ID.

Broad credential-config consumers no longer treat SSH filename mentions as credential acquisition. The FreeBSD sweep retains its original explicit private-key-path alternative under the new neutral ID.
Broad anti-static/imports consumers retain complete API-concealment composites; raw multipliers and hash bytes no longer count as standalone import hiding.

Generic fs and metadata/binary directory consumers still select factual operations and structural properties. Target rescans show no accidental hostile promotion; name/path and arithmetic controls remain non-hostile.

validation.target_rescans: atomscan --no-update --mode slow -f json on all three original sample paths

judgment_markers./usr/local/var/cyclotron/tmp.noindex/cyc: cftunnel bundle: Defender bypass and task persistence; fix traits
Windows stealer: browser-key theft and upload; fix API traits
Udydn bridge: shell tasking and log erasure; fix deletion traits
